title: Gravedigger with Shovel at Open Grave, 1930s Cemetery Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A poignant full-length snapshot capturing an elderly cemetery caretaker or gravedigger leaning on his shovel beside a freshly dug grave plot. He wears classic working-class workwear of the era, including denim bib overalls, an undershirt, and a tweed flat cap. Sunlight streams through the foliage above, creating a soft glow behind him. In the background stand several family gravestones with legible surnames including 'FREDERICKS' and 'MONKS / BURLINGAME'. The print features distinctive scalloped deckled edges characteristic of mid-1930s amateur snapshots.
